mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.news_id AS newsId, s.user_id AS userId, s.status, n.title, n.image, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS activityTime, DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS signupTime FROM activity_signup s INNER JOIN news n ON s.news_id = n.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 1 AND n.status = 1 ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.news_id AS newsId, s.user_id AS userId, s.status, DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS signupTime, u.nick_name AS userName, u.phone FROM activity_signup s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.news_id = #{newsId} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.create_time ASC
